name.en: Corrugated board, double wall, BC flute
name.es: Cartón corrugado de doble pared, flauta BC
name.pt: Papelão ondulado de parede dupla, ondas BC

gsm.basis: implied by the construction block (pliego.board v1)

caliper_um.basis: implied by the construction block (pliego.board v1)

E_md_gpa.basis: implied by the construction block (pliego.board v1)

E_cd_gpa.basis: implied by the construction block (pliego.board v1)

nu.basis: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981); the board value is unmeasured [E]

crease_length_scale_t.basis: scored board: L* = 50–100 t (memo §a3, Beex & Peerlings 2009 qualitative); mid value [E]

crease_yield_deg.basis: rest opening 27–43° after creasing (Lechenault 2014, Mylar); board unmeasured [E]

fabrication.score: required: crease-rule every fold (the flutes crush along the score)

layers.basis: kraft liner 125 g/m²: caliper ≈ 694.44 g/cm³ [E]; moduli as kraft-120 (Mondi TDS MD/CD ratio) [E]
fluting medium 112 g/m² [E]; recycled/semi-chemical fluting stiffer in MD than CD (MD/CD ≈ 2.3) [E]
kraft liner 125 g/m²: caliper ≈ 694.44 g/cm³ [E]; moduli as kraft-120 (Mondi TDS MD/CD ratio) [E]
fluting medium 112 g/m² [E]; recycled/semi-chemical fluting stiffer in MD than CD (MD/CD ≈ 2.3) [E]
kraft liner 125 g/m²: caliper ≈ 694.44 g/cm³ [E]; moduli as kraft-120 (Mondi TDS MD/CD ratio) [E]

construction.note: Top layer first (the board's front). Flutes run across the machine direction (axes along CD). Adhesive: starch, 5 g/m² per glue line [E].

provenance.author: Innovaciones MADFAM
sources: Foster 1997, Wiley Encyclopedia of Packaging Technology — flute designations as tabled in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corrugated_fiberboard
Rogalka, Grabski & Garbowski 2023, Identification of Geometric Features of the Corrugated Board Using Images and Genetic Algorithm, Sensors 23(13):6242, Table 1 — https://doi.org/10.3390/s23136242

Classical sandwich-beam theory (Allen 1969, Analysis and Design of Structural Sandwich Panels) and corrugated-board homogenisation without transverse shear (Nordstrand 2003, Lund University doctoral thesis) [L]
Baum, Habeger & Fleischman 1981, Measurement of the orthotropic elastic constants of paper — https://bioresources.cnr.ncsu.edu/resources/measurement-of-the-orthotropic-elastic-constants-of-paper/
Pliego research memo rsE (2026-10-10) §a3/§b — engineering estimates [E]; scored board L* = 50–100 t (Beex & Peerlings 2009, qualitative) — https://orbilu.uni.lu/handle/10993/17431

units.laminate: A N/m, B N, D N*m

caliper_mm.basis: derived.thickness; physical.caliper_um estimated: implied by the construction block (pliego.board v1)

areal_density_kg_m2.basis: derived.areal_density (g/mm²) × 1000; physical.gsm estimated: implied by the construction block (pliego.board v1)

E1t.basis: derived.E_md × t; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: implied by the construction block (pliego.board v1); physical.caliper_um estimated: implied by the construction block (pliego.board v1)

E2t.basis: derived.E_cd × t; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: implied by the construction block (pliego.board v1); physical.caliper_um estimated: implied by the construction block (pliego.board v1)

G12t.basis: derived.G12 × t, G12 = 0.387·√(E_md·E_cd) (Baum, Brennan & Habeger 1981, via pliego.stock.derive v1)

nu12.basis: ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd): the card's ν is the geometric mean √(ν12·ν21), split by reciprocity ν12/E1 = ν21/E2; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981); the board value is unmeasured [E]

D11.basis: derived.D_md × 1e-9 (N·m): sandwich bending about the MD neutral axis, Σ E·(t³/12 + t·(z − z̄)²)/(1 − ν²) over the card's construction block (pliego.board v1, Allen 1969) via pliego.stock.derive v1, transverse shear of the core not included; construction.layers ['estimated']; flute heights per pliego.board v1; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981); the board value is unmeasured [E]

D22.basis: derived.D_cd × 1e-9 (N·m): sandwich bending about the CD neutral axis, Σ E·(t³/12 + t·(z − z̄)²)/(1 − ν²) over the card's construction block (pliego.board v1, Allen 1969) via pliego.stock.derive v1, transverse shear of the core not included; construction.layers ['estimated']; flute heights per pliego.board v1; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981); the board value is unmeasured [E]

D12.basis: D*12, the free-stack D* = D − B·A⁻¹·B of the laminate block, which rebuilds the construction layer by layer (hyperobjects_sheet.board): liners and plies with ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd); the medium carries no Poisson term

D66.basis: D*66, the free-stack D* = D − B·A⁻¹·B of the laminate block, which rebuilds the construction layer by layer (hyperobjects_sheet.board): liners and plies with ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd) and the Baum estimate G12 = 0.387·√(E_md·E_cd) per layer; the medium's in-plane shear is neglected, as pliego.board v1 neglects its MD load, so this is a lower bound

crease_length_scale_t.basis: physical.crease_length_scale_t estimated: scored board: L* = 50–100 t (memo §a3, Beex & Peerlings 2009 qualitative); mid value [E]

crease_yield_deg.basis: physical.crease_yield_deg estimated: rest opening 27–43° after creasing (Lechenault 2014, Mylar); board unmeasured [E]

crease_set_rate.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.crease_set_rate)

score_factor.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.score_factor)

notes: friction: the card states one paper-on-paper coefficient; it is written as friction_static, and friction_kinetic and damping are left out rather than invented

board: the laminate block rebuilds the card's construction (pliego.board v1) as a classical laminate about the mid-plane; its free-stack D* gives D11 +0.00 % and D22 +0.00 % against the card's D_md and D_cd, which are kept (D* also carries the Poisson cross terms the card's per-direction sums omit)
board: B is non-zero (|B|/√(|A|·|D|) = 0.0549): the stack is asymmetric, so stretching and bending are coupled and it curls under in-plane load or a layer's pre-strain

board: a medium layer is a slab as thick as its flute height that carries CD load only; its own bending is the sinusoid's spread α·E·t_m·(t_m²/12 + a²/2)/(1 − ν²), neither the plate nor a card value, so its record states no own_bending
